coverage_assessment: First-pass open-web research saved for review: 26 captured searches, 133 source cards, fifteen provisional candidates, zero exclusions, zero continuations and thirteen evidence gaps. Searches cover all four January weeks, student and labor actions, women, environmental, health and service sectors, Ankara, Istanbul and other provinces, plus discovery-level December/February boundary leads. The Jan 21 TİHV record reports eight Kadıköy detentions versus nine in S007; turnout remains unknown. A Jan 21 Tunceli/Dersim HDP statement is directly reported by PİRHA and substantially overlaps a Jan 22 Özgür Gelecek report; source dependence and attendance >=50 remain unresolved. Batman/İzmir Jan 29 execution, crowd thresholds, demands, publicness and event boundaries remain open. Coverage is incomplete and not exhaustive; official baseline, archive equivalence, required audit and coordinator review remain pending.
